_about: Monetization and audience configuration. NOTHING here is a measured number unless you put it here yourself: the audience stats ship empty and the /advertise/ page renders them only when filled. Never hard-code a traffic figure anywhere else.

audienceStats._note: Fill from Search Console / GA4 and set asOf + source. Leave a value null to hide it. Example: {"label": "Monthly organic clicks", "value": "12,400", "period": "last 28 days", "source": "Google Search Console"}

formats.name: Sponsored guide
formats.text: A clearly labelled guide or section written with your input about a place, service or experience in Nashik. Published with a visible "Sponsored" label, a disclosure line, and rel="sponsored nofollow" on every outbound link.

formats.name: Featured listing
formats.text: A labelled listing for a hotel, tour, restaurant or vineyard on a relevant page. Listings are never mixed into editorial rankings or "best of" picks.

formats.name: Newsletter sponsorship
formats.text: A labelled sponsor slot in the Kumbh 2027 updates channel, once that channel has subscribers to report.

formats.name: Kumbh-season banner
formats.text: A labelled banner placement on selected Kumbh pages during the peak period.

signup._note: Provider wiring is read from the environment at build time: NT_SIGNUP_FORM_ACTION (a form POST URL from Buttondown / Mailchimp / Formspree / Google Forms) and/or NT_WHATSAPP_CHANNEL_URL. With neither set, the block links to the contact form so it never shows a dead button.
signup.heading: Kumbh 2027 updates
signup.text: Get a short message when a verified Kumbh notice changes: dates, passes, roads or transport. No spam, and you can leave at any time.

affiliates._note: Affiliate parameters per partner host. Set via environment, e.g. NT_AFFILIATE_MAKEMYTRIP='affid=123&utm_source=nt' (querystring, no leading ?). Unset = plain link. Hosts listed here get rel="sponsored nofollow noopener" either way.

analytics._note: GA4 already runs. These add a cookieless counter only when the env var is set at build time.
